introHtml: Good Value pet leashes offer a reliable, budget-friendly option for businesses needing branded giveaways or retail stock. Made from durable nylon webbing with a strong metal clip, these leashes are available in various widths and lengths to suit dogs of all sizes. Choose from standard imprint colors for logo placement on the leash body or clip. Perfect for pet adoption events, vet clinics, or corporate swag bags, these leashes keep your brand visible during daily walks.
